rating_rationale: Reported liquidity is large relative to the request, but leverage, historical operating cash use, bitcoin exposure, and incomplete private diligence warrant heightened monitoring.
reversal_trigger: Increase only after a refreshed borrowing-entity cash forecast and debt schedule support repayment without collateral, or after additional eligible collateral raises the binding cap without another policy breach; decline if ownership, priority, control, price freshness, or the repayment route is not evidenced.
source_coverage_scope: All 13 material public filing facts used in the model and memo map to SRC-001 or SRC-002; this rate does not measure private-diligence completeness.
